The common prompt says this is a small extension smoke test and each teammate should complete its individual instructions, report completion to main, then remain idle. Individual instructions: write alpha-started.txt or beta-started.txt (respectively) containing the teammate's name, and report completion through the team tool. Use the new tool names the extension provides. Do not ask me questions. Do not schedule reminders for this short test. If a tool fails, investigate the response and record the exact failure in the result file rather than claiming success.

</file>
